metadata.note: Second set of 500 foods, with no dishes repeated from top_500_foods.json or indian_states_top20_foods.json. Covers all 28 Indian states (17-18 dishes each). Values are approximate per-serving estimates for typical portions (not lab-tested); recipes, oil use and portions vary, so treat as roughly +/-20-25%. Some northeastern and tribal dishes are regional variants with less standardized recipes. calories_per_100 is kcal per 100 g (or 100 ml for beverages); protein_per_100 is g per 100 g (null for beverages).
